name: Earth comet outpost (placeholder)
role: Earth's early-warning station in the Oort Cloud, built into a comet nucleus (design section 3): turrets, a hangar that scrambles interceptors, a scanner, and the comms array that warns the inner system. A placeholder until the real model exists: a procedural ice nucleus (look.rock, about 1.1 km across) with a station hull on top (look.hull). When ShipArt has an earth_outpost model, it replaces the placeholder by this class name and its parts come from the model. It does not move (FS2's installations do not).

sideDamp.source: Estimate: capital ships do not slide in FS2; set equal to the turn damping

mass.source: Estimate (FS2 takes mass from the 3D model); only scales how hard knocks shove the ship

size.source: The Oort mission's placeholder: an ice nucleus of radius 420 m stretched (1.3, 0.85, 1.1) with the station on top
